svg.aria-label: Pusula — Never stop coding: when one quota runs out, the next provider answers. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Cline talk to Pusula instead of a single vendor. It keeps the keys and sign-ins for hundreds of providers, serves them through one OpenAI-compatible endpoint, falls back automatically and stacks RTK and Caveman compression so prompts cost fewer tokens. A rebrand and continuation of OmniRoute (MIT), kept in sync with upstream.
